verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is API-first: sessions, scraping, crawling, extraction, agents, sandboxes, profiles, recordings, stealth/CAPTCHA solving are all exposed via API/SDK/CLI, and the dashboard is largely a viewer over the same session/agent primitives rather than a separate feature surface. missing for 10: no public OpenAPI spec was found (404s on probes), and no explicit statement confirming every dashboard-only setting (e.g., billing/team management) is API-controllable.
